---
title: Damped oscillator
---

The Julia simulation used a damping ratio of
$\zeta = {{< ckvalue results/sim.json zeta >}}$.
Fitting the decay of its peaks in the [analysis](analysis.html) gives
$\zeta = {{< ckvalue results/fit.json zeta .4f >}}$
from {{< ckvalue results/fit.json n_peaks >}} peaks,
whose envelope is shown in @fig-decay.

{{< embed analysis.ipynb#fig-decay >}}

The fit is a straight line through the logarithm of the peaks
(@fig-peaks), listed in @tbl-peaks.

::: {.ckfigure src="figures/peaks.svg" #fig-peaks width="70%"}
Peaks of the displacement on a log scale, with the fitted decay.
:::

::: {.cktable src="results/peaks.csv" #tbl-peaks rows="5"}
The first peaks, which the fit uses.
:::

The simulation's phase portrait (@fig-phase) spirals in to rest.

```{r}
#| label: fig-phase
#| fig-cap: Phase portrait.
sim <- read.csv("data/sim.csv")
plot(sim$x, sim$v, type = "l", xlab = "x", ylab = "v", asp = 1)
```
